entries.en: Forked subagents can now be enabled on external builds by setting `CLAUDE_CODE_FORK_SUBAGENT=1`
entries.zh: 外部构建版本现在可以通过设置 `CLAUDE_CODE_FORK_SUBAGENT=1` 启用分叉子代理

entries.en: OpenTelemetry: `user_prompt` events now include `command_name` and `command_source` for slash commands; `cost.usage`, `token.usage`, `api_request`, and `api_error` now include an `effort` attribute when the model supports effort levels. Custom/MCP command names are redacted unless `OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS=1` is set
entries.zh: OpenTelemetry：`user_prompt` 事件对斜杠命令新增 `command_name` 和 `command_source`；当模型支持 effort 级别时，`cost.usage`、`token.usage`、`api_request` 和 `api_error` 新增 `effort` 属性。除非设置 `OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS=1`，否则自定义或 MCP 命令名会被脱敏

entries.en: Improved `/model`: selections now persist across restarts even when the project pins a different model, and the startup header shows when the active model comes from a project or managed-settings pin
entries.zh: 改进 `/model`：即使项目固定了其他模型，选择也会在重启后保留；启动页头会显示当前模型是来自项目还是托管设置的固定

entries.en: The `/resume` command now offers to summarize stale, large sessions before re-reading them, matching the existing `--resume` behavior
entries.zh: `/resume` 命令在重新读取过时的大型会话前，现在会先提示是否要先总结，与 `--resume` 的现有行为一致

entries.en: Faster startup when both local and claude.ai MCP servers are configured (concurrent connect now default)
entries.zh: 配置本地和 claude.ai MCP 服务器时启动速度更快（现在默认为并发连接）

entries.en: `plugin install` on an already-installed plugin now installs any missing dependencies instead of stopping at "already installed"
entries.zh: 对已安装的插件执行 `plugin install` 时，现在会安装缺失的依赖，而不是停在 "already installed"

entries.en: Plugin dependency errors now say "not installed" with an install hint, and `claude plugin marketplace add` now auto-resolves missing dependencies from configured marketplaces
entries.zh: 插件依赖错误现在会显示「未安装」并附带安装提示；`claude plugin marketplace add` 现在会从已配置的市场自动解析缺失的依赖

entries.en: Managed-settings `blockedMarketplaces` and `strictKnownMarketplaces` are now enforced on plugin install, update, refresh, and autoupdate
entries.zh: 托管设置中的 `blockedMarketplaces` 和 `strictKnownMarketplaces` 现在会在插件安装、更新、刷新和自动更新时强制执行

entries.en: The `cleanupPeriodDays` retention sweep now also covers `~/.claude/tasks/`, `~/.claude/shell-snapshots/`, and `~/.claude/backups/`
entries.zh: `cleanupPeriodDays` 的保留清理现在也覆盖 `~/.claude/tasks/`、`~/.claude/shell-snapshots/` 和 `~/.claude/backups/`

entries.en: Native builds on macOS and Linux: the `Glob` and `Grep` tools are replaced by embedded `bfs` and `ugrep` available through the Bash tool — faster searches without a separate tool round-trip (Windows and npm-installed builds unchanged)
entries.zh: macOS 和 Linux 原生构建版：`Glob` 和 `Grep` 工具被内置的 `bfs` 和 `ugrep` 取代，通过 Bash 工具即可使用，搜索更快，且无需额外的工具往返（Windows 和 npm 安装版不变）

entries.en: Windows: cached `where.exe` executable lookups per process for faster subprocess launches
entries.zh: Windows：每个进程缓存 `where.exe` 的可执行文件查找结果，子进程启动更快

entries.en: Default effort for Pro/Max subscribers on Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6 is now `high` (was `medium`)
entries.zh: Opus 4.6 和 Sonnet 4.6 上 Pro/Max 订阅者的默认努力现在为“高”（原为“中”）

entries.en: Agent frontmatter `mcpServers` are now loaded for main-thread agent sessions via `--agent`
entries.zh: 现在通过`--agent`为主线程代理会话加载代理前端`mcpServers`

entries.en: Advisor Tool (experimental): dialog now carries an "experimental" label, learn-more link, and startup notification when enabled; sessions no longer get stuck with "Advisor tool result content could not be processed" errors on every prompt and `/compact`
entries.zh: Advisor Tool（实验性）：对话框现在带有“实验性”标签、了解更多链接以及启用时的启动通知；会话不再在每个提示和`/compact`上陷入“无法处理顾问工具结果内容”错误

entries.en: Fixed Plain-CLI OAuth sessions dying with "Please run /login" when the access token expires mid-session — the token is now refreshed reactively on 401
entries.zh: 修复了当访问令牌在会话中过期时，Plain-CLI OAuth 会话因“请运行/登录”而终止的问题 — 令牌现在会在 401 上响应式刷新

entries.en: Fixed `WebFetch` hanging on very large HTML pages by truncating input before HTML-to-markdown conversion
entries.zh: 通过在 HTML 到 Markdown 转换之前截断输入，修复了挂在非常大的 HTML 页面上的`WebFetch`

entries.en: Fixed a crash when a proxy returns HTTP 204 No Content — now surfaces a clear error instead of a `TypeError`
entries.zh: 修复了代理返回 HTTP 204 No Content 时发生的崩溃 — 现在显示一个明显的错误，而不是`TypeError`

entries.en: Fixed `/login` having no effect when launched with `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN` env var and that token expires
entries.zh: 修复了使用`CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN`环境变量启动且该令牌过期时`/login`无效的问题

entries.en: Fixed prompt-input undo (`Ctrl+_`) doing nothing immediately after typing, and skipping a state on each undo step
entries.zh: 修复了提示输入撤消（`Ctrl+_`）在键入后立即不执行任何操作，并在每个撤消步骤中跳过状态

entries.en: Fixed `NO_PROXY` not being respected for remote API requests when running under Bun
entries.zh: 修复了在 Bun 下运行时远程 API 请求不遵守`NO_PROXY`的问题

entries.en: Fixed rare spurious escape/return triggers when key names arrive as coalesced text over slow connections
entries.zh: 修复了当键名称通过慢速连接作为合并文本到达时罕见的虚假转义/返回触发器

entries.en: Fixed SDK `reload_plugins` reconnecting all user MCP servers serially
entries.zh: 修复了 SDK`reload_plugins`串行重新连接所有用户 MCP 服务器的问题

entries.en: Fixed Bedrock application-inference-profile requests failing with 400 when backed by Opus 4.7 with thinking disabled
entries.zh: 修复了由 Opus 4.7 支持且禁用思考时的 Bedrock 应用程序推理配置文件请求失败并显示 400

entries.en: Fixed MCP `elicitation/create` requests auto-cancelling in print/SDK mode when the server finishes connecting mid-turn
entries.zh: 修复了当服务器中途完成连接时，MCP“诱导/创建”请求在打印/SDK 模式下自动取消的问题

entries.en: Fixed subagents running a different model than the main agent incorrectly flagging file reads with a malware warning
entries.zh: 修复了运行与主代理不同模型的子代理错误地标记文件读取并带有恶意软件警告的问题

entries.en: Fixed idle re-render loop when background tasks are present, reducing memory growth on Linux
entries.zh: 修复了存在后台任务时的空闲重新渲染循环，减少了 Linux 上的内存增长

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed "Manage Plugins" panel breaking when multiple large marketplaces are configured
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复配置了多个大型插件市场时，"Manage Plugins" 面板崩溃的问题

entries.en: Fixed Opus 4.7 sessions showing inflated `/context` percentages and autocompacting too early — Claude Code was computing against a 200K context window instead of Opus 4.7's native 1M
entries.zh: 修复了 Opus 4.7 会话显示膨胀的`/context`百分比和过早自动压缩的问题 - Claude Code 是针对 200K 上下文窗口而不是 Opus 4.7 的原生 1M 进行计算
